versions.content: Bit 3 of Byte 0 of the FrameIDFlexRay shall contain a flag indicating whether the reported slot ID and cycle are valid (flag is 1 ) or unused (flag is 0 ). It shall only be set to 0 when an aggregated error of the FlexRay channels is reported independently of a source frame or transmission conflict. Otherwise it shall always be set to 1 .
